name_original: Panasonic - HC-VX870K 4K Ultra HD Flash Memory Camcorder - Black
description_original: Preserve important moments with this Panasonic HC-VX870K camcorder, which features a BSI MOS sensor that captures stunning footage with up to 4K Ultra HD (3840 x 2160) resolution and clear stereo sound. Hybrid image stabilization ensures smooth videos.
